sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Flame, the Lion Dance Grandmaster (舞狮尊主 烈焰) is a story - region finale encounter in Pangzhen, found at Second half of Pangzhen, unmissable. Beating it yields Flaming Mane.

sections.title: Where to Find the Flame, the Lion Dance Grandmaster (舞狮尊主 烈焰)
sections.content:
Location: Second half of Pangzhen, unmissable.

Appears in: Pangzhen.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It closes out its region and is mandatory, so there is no route around it.

sections.title: How to Beat the Flame, the Lion Dance Grandmaster (舞狮尊主 烈焰)
sections.content:
What works

  • Counter the fire attacks with water-based abilities; the fight is unmissable in the second half of Pangzhen.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 30 of 60 in the progression order, in Pangzhen. Before it: You Loong, Blackwater Crew Leader (游龙). After it: Soulclaimer (勾魂). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
